title: Proof You Don't Need a Driver's License or Registration Under Your Constitutional Right to Travel
summary: Promoter argues US code definitions and court quotes mean private travelers need no license, registration or adherence to the motor vehicle code.

assertions.quote: so that means you have the right to travel without a driver's license or registration
it's only a motor vehicle if it's used for commercial purposes
according to the US code and the Supreme Court you do not need a driver's license
code is actually a constructive contract
by handing that to the police officer you're saying I'm operating commercially

verdicts.note: Ordinary licenses are non-commercial and showing one creates no commercial status or contract.

assertions.quote: most likely they're gonna either give you a ticket or arrest you
